row: Welcome to my YouTube channel, where I share expert techniques in deep tissue sports massage and recovery. I specialise in helping athletes optimise performance and recover faster using a combination of therapies, including fire cupping, massage blades, and advanced equipment like Game Ready, Pulsio, and Normatec. I also demonstrate sports taping methods to support healing, prevent injuries, and enhance overall recovery. Tune in for valuable tips, insights, and demonstrations to take your recovery and performance to the next level.  Let me know in the comments if you would like to see the treatment and training and games on a live?
